description:

Guy Fieri's diving into chicken, noodles and more; an Omaha joint is going big with pasta and cheese, a champion chef in Los Angeles is prepping for a Nashville-Chinese mashup and an Italian spot in Greenwich, Conn., is putting out elevated dishes.

description:

description:

description:
S03 E17 — Hogs and Dogs
Noah arrives at The Great Frederick Fair in Maryland, where he enjoys the Whole Hog, the Crabby Dog and the Cake-a-Dilla; Noah visits New York's Wyoming County Fair and samples the Monster Veggie Wrap, the Mexita and the Exploding Fireball Taffy.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E16 — Feast and Fries
Noah visits the Paris Fair in Ontario, Canada for Her Majesty's Feast, meat pie poutine, the Dirtburger and Maddy Moo's Wrap Attack; the Washington County Fair in New York for Sugar Shack cotton candy, Bleu Ribbon Fries and the Twisted S'More.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S04 E02 — Drive-Thru Redo
Kardea makes a double patty veggie burger with a special sauce that goes perfectly with oven-baked onion rings; she also makes a baked apple hand pie and chocolate fro-yo shake for dessert.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S05 E11 — Bridge Run Brunch
After a bridge run workout with friends, Kardea Brown invites everyone back to her house for brunch; seafood omelet bar with all the fixings, candied bacon, peaches and cream scones, and refreshing sparkling mimosas.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S07 E05 — Jazzed Up Supper Club
Kardea Brown throws together a jazz-inspired supper club with chef Alexander Smalls; the menu includes fish chowder, grilled lamb chops with pink peppercorn sauce, fried skillet corn salad and red wine poached pears with vanilla bean custard.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S09 E04 — Kardea's Spooktacular Party
Kardea Brown hosts Halloween in her new home and throws an all-out party for her friends and family; with a menu featuring pepperoni mummy stromboli, sheet pan tomato soup, Jack-o'-Lantern jambalaya stuffed peppers, and graveyard ice cream pie.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S09 E01 — Tasty Treats to Go
Pumpkin cinnamon rolls; sticky sweet baklava; white chocolate shortbread cookies; chocolate-dipped strawberries.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S12 E10 — Special Day
Fun treats for a late-afternoon picnic, including animal crackers, crunchy cereal chicken fingers, cucumber finger sandwiches, salad on a stick and watermelon mini wedges.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S33 E06 — No Fail Fall
Ree Drummond cooks some no-fail fall favorites, starting with an autumn steak salad and a one-pan fall chicken skillet, then, she prepares Santa Fe eggs in purgatory for an all-day breakfast and her quick mini chocolate tarts.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S39 E05 — Chocolate Memories
Ree takes a trip down memory lane by sharing chocolate recipes that are special to her. She makes chocolate cake with 7-minute frosting, chocolate rice pudding, Ree's chocolate cereal treats, and the best mini chocolate chip cookies.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S15 E01 — Spooky Surprises
Treats for Halloween; Jeff Mauro's monster mac and cheese; Katie Lee's butternut squash soup; frightening food crafts; pass the cauldron cake; the piece of cake Halloween party is packed with great ideas and a Shirley Temple of doom.

title: The Kitchen: World on a Plate
description: The Kitchen makes delicious bites inspired by countries all over the world.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E04 — Yotam Ottolenghi
Garten welcomes award-winning chef Dan Barber for lively conversation about catering coincidences, high-pressure hospitality, and redefining restaurant reviews. Plus, Ina makes Cornmeal Pound Cake, and Dan shares his recipe for Miso Crusted Squash.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E01 — Christina Tosi
Pastry chef and Milk Bar founder Christina Tosi joins Ina Garten to share stories about life-changing career decisions and dessert revelations; Ina makes Smoked Salmon Tartines, and Christina shares the secrets to Milk Bar's legendary Birthday Cake.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E03 — Back from the Dead: Misfit Monsters
Bennett asks the teams to go head-to-head with terrifying trolls, demons and ghouls. But as rivalries heat up and tensions rise, one team faces an emotional fight to impress judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller enough to stay in the competition.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E04 — Back from the Dead: Storybook Nightmares
Twisted bedtime stories come to life as Jonathan Bennett asks the five remaining teams to create terrifying moving showpieces inspired by classic tales; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which team's story has come to an end.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E05 — Back from the Dead: Nightmare Pet Shop
Monstrous pets take over as Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create haunted pet shop showpieces and pumpkin-infused desserts; a surprise carving battle puts the teams to the test before judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller make their decision.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E06 — Back from the Dead: Final Four
As the race to the finale heats up, Jonathan Bennett challenges the final four teams to create terrifying toys and elevated treats inspired by childhood favorites; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which teams earn a pass to the finale.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E07 — Back from the Dead: The Final Fright
Jonathan Bennett challenges the final teams to create killer carnival showpieces, interactive games and elevated carnival treats; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide who will be crowned Halloween Wars champion and take home $30,000.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S11 E03 — Engrossed With Ghosts
Host John Henson has a close encounter with a ghost that inspires ghostly transformation desserts; one supernatural sweet scares up $1,000 after impressing judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S11 E04 — Messages From Beyond
Henson asks the bakers to make cryptic message desserts that reveal an eerie dispatch from the other side. Judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell must decide who wins $1,000 for their mysterious missive and whose message now reads exit.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S11 E05 — Flawed Anatomy
Creativity turns creepy as John Henson asks the bakers to craft a horrifying fusion of two beings into one spliced souls dessert; judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell decide which baker best captures the terror of transformation.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S11 E06 — It All Begins With Us
It's the semifinals, and in honor of Pennywise the Clown, John Henson asks the bakers to make desserts inspired by the monster that haunted them as a child; the bottom three bakers must fight to make it to the finale.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S11 E07 — Happy Haunting Grounds
John Henson asks the bakers to make haunted grounds desserts to impress judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell; the final bakers must create a most feared demise cake to win $25,000 and the title of Halloween Baking Champion!

title: Selena + Restaurant
description:
S01 E01 — Selena + CUT Steakhouse
Selena Gomez's culinary adventure takes her to Beverly Hills, the home of Chef Wolfgang Puck's gorgeous CUT steakhouse; Wolfgang gives Selena two kitchen initiation tests before she gets the chance to create her own spicy seafood dish for his menu.

title: Selena + Restaurant
description:
S01 E05 — Selena + Girl & the Goat
Selena Gomez steps up her game in Stephanie Izard's kitchen, where she is challenged with a taste test; for her special, Selena makes a ricotta toast inspired by cheese and crackers in hopes of dazzling Stephanie with a cheesy, crunchy creation.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S07 E02 — Jon Batiste
Musician Jon Batiste joins Ina Garten for a conversation about staying strong and making Grammy history; Ina makes peanut butter and jelly bars for a taste of nostalgia and Jon shares his Ma's Louisiana-style red beans and rice.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S07 E03 — Hoda Kotb
Hoda Kotb joins Ina Garten to talk about memories and game-changing moments; Ina shows Hoda how to assemble an Easy Mezze Board with Marinated Herbed Feta that is perfect for effortless entertaining; they make Fried Chicken Sandwiches.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S15 E07 — Kit for Cowboy Cameron
Ree welcomes Cowboy Cameron to the ranch with a frontier-style dinner kit of his favorite food; short rib sandwiches; roasted butternut squash salad; salted caramel frosted brownies; sweet tea lemonade.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S23 E12 — Moving House
There's a new cowboy on the ranch, and Ree Drummond is making him dinner to go and sharing the epic story of delivering his massive, ready-built house; the main course is an easy chicken jalapeño popper casserole with fresh-baked pretzel rolls.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S28 E12 — 16-Minute Meals: Cowboy Favorites
Ree Drummond is sharing 16-minute favorites for cowboys and cowgirls; she makes steak medallions and potatoes, gnocchi with chorizo and corn, crisp in a pinch and finally a chicken jalapeño popper quesadilla.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S33 E11 — Thinking Thrifty
Ree Drummond thinks thrifty with meals that are budget-friendly and big on flavor, like hearty veggie ragù with cheesy polenta, a 16-minute creamy pork chop pasta, stunning slow cooker chicken verde burritos, and her mash-up cheeseburger bowls.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S38 E14 — New House Brunch
Ree Drummond is hosting a Tex-Mex brunch in her new home and serving a make-ahead spread with spicy Breakfast Enchiladas, a Churro French Toast Bake with Chocolate Butter, and a marvelous Mango Salad that's so delicious!

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S39 E09 — Ree's New Garden
Ree Drummond is adding her fresh garden ingredients to recipes, starting with moist chocolate zucchini muffins; Ree also makes easy best ever pesto, a tomato sandwich, a green goddess chopped salad and spicy herb garden butter.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S14 E10 — Quick and Easy Fall Favorites
Chicken chili; seasonal fall stir-fry; cheesy chicken pasta with broccoli and bacon; caramel apple bomb pie; pear bubbly.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S22 E10 — Fall Fan Favorites
New twists on viewers' fall favorites include Sunny Anderson's mini meatloaves Cheat Sheet and Geoffrey Zakarian's pumpkin, bacon and caramelized onion quiche; cookbook author Samantha Seneviratne bakes a maple cream pie.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E06 — Handheld Hits
The Kitchen is serving up handheld bites perfect for a tailgate or outdoor party; Spiked Lemon Iced Tea, Deviled Chicken Wings, Bacon Bow Tie Crackers and Herb Dip and Carmelitas; guest Tony Shalhoub shares his recipe for Spinach Fatayer.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E04 — Up to No Good
Hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the baking teams to create supersized "Harry Potter" artifacts that reveal something from within; special guest Afshan Azad joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E05 — Magical Beasts, Beings, and Creatures
James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining four baking teams to create showpieces that bring a Harry Potter creature to life, along with a bold smoky or spicy tasting element; special guest Warwick Davis joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E06 — The Goblet of Fire
For the finale in the Great Hall, James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create showpieces celebrating the Goblet of Fire; guest judges Warwick Davis, Afshan Azad and Devon Murray join Carla Hall to award the Wizards of Baking trophy.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S01 E04 — The Great 8 Teams Sleigh
The randomizer is dialed to extra naughty as the victorious Great Eight teams return for the second round; only two teams will sleigh their matchups and move one step closer to the title, the trophy, $100,000, and major charity cash.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S01 E05 — Jingle All the Way to the Finals
The remaining Great Eight teams fight for their spot in the Final Four; with the championship within reach, the stakes have never been higher; who can keep jingling all the way to the finale?

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S01 E06 — A Christmas Champion Is Crowned
Guy Fieri welcomes the final four culinary teams back to the festive battlefield for two jolly head-to-heads; only one team can walk away with the trophy, the glory, big bucks for charity and a sleigh-load of $100,000!

description:

A team of celebrity chefs battle rival restaurant lines to win $25,000.

description:
S30 E02 — Reality Check: Hollywood's Next Culinary Star
Chefs Jeff and Tiffany teach the teams a soup and sandwich combo before tackling the main dish challenge of eggplant Parmesan and handmade pasta; the bottom two recruits must battle it out in a blind elimination appetizer cook-off.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S11 E10 — First Time for Everything
Falafel with chipotle tahini dip piled into a pita; chicken and waffles with a decadent maple syrup and bourbon sauce; upside-down tarte Tatin with caramel, apples, and a store-bought pastry shortcut.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S16 E02 — All In A Morning's Work
Ree Drummond fixes up a warming lunch; chunky beef chili; a cowboy favorite with two kinds of beef; cheesy quesadilla; individual caramel cakes.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S34 E11 — Breakfast Bakes 4 Ways
Ree rises and shines with four delicious breakfast bakes; she starts with maple pancake cake, puts a savory spin on breakfast monkey bread, fills the oven with a puff pastry quiche and ends with a sausage and pepper grits bake.

title: The Kitchen: World on a Plate
description: The Kitchen makes delicious bites inspired by countries all over the world.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E11 — Tastes Like Home
The hosts are sharing nostalgic bites from their hometowns, like baked steak and gravy, New England clam dip and an authentic Chicago-style pizza pillow puff; chocolate pudding and cream roll cake is inspired by a well-loved sweet treat.

title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
description:
S01 E07 — Bigs & Littles
For each team, Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown ask the older sibling to make one big dessert and the younger sibling to make a dozen little desserts; the teammates can talk to each other, but they can't work on each other's desserts!

title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
description:
S01 E08 — Hat Tricks
Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown task the final sibling teams with creating "Cat in the Hat" helper desserts; they must craft a large, non-cake dessert featuring a joyful animal character.

title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
description:
S01 E09 — Cake to Move You
For the final challenge, Goldman and Kardea Brown ask the sibling teams to create a delicious cake that gives a stunning animated illusion as the cake spins around; the winning team walks away with $25,000 and the title of Next Gen Baking Champions.

title: Kids Baking Championship
description:
Kids Baking Championship: Frosting the Snowman
Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown challenge four kid bakers to bake up handmade gifts for the underappreciated residents of the North Pole; the kid who bakes the best gift will go home with a $10,000 prize package of seasonal baking tools.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E04 — Island Holiday Party
To celebrate the release of Disney's Moana 2, host Jeff Mauro tasks the six remaining teams with imagining what a holiday party on the island of Motunui would look like; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown decide which team is eliminated.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E05 — Mrs. Claus' Night Out
Host Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a scene capturing what it looks like when Mrs. Claus has a night out on the town and the cookie artists are in the spotlight; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown eliminate one more team.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E06 — Santa's Stand-In
Host Jeff Mauro asks the teams to imagine what holiday hijinks unfold when another holiday icon fills in for Santa on Christmas Eve; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown determine which three teams move forward.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E07 — Woodland Winter Games
Host Jeff Mauro challenges the three remaining teams to create a scene that features woodland animals going for gold in an Olympic event; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown determine which two teams head to the finale.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E08 — Pet, Meet Christmas Tree
For the final challenge, Jeff Mauro asks the two teams to imagine the hilarity that ensues when a pet takes on the family Christmas tree; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown decide who will be crowned champion and take home the prize of $25,000.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E01 — Welcome to Santa's Workshop
Host Palmer divides the 12 bakers into two teams and challenges them to make holiday stained-glass cakes; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh decide the winner of a $1,000 prize package, and one baker from the losing team is eliminated.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Love is in the air as actress Kaley Cuoco and Scott Conant team up with pastry chefs and spouses, Melissa and Sean McGaughey, for a bittersweet battle against Bobby Flay.

Comedian and movie podcaster Paul Scheer and Katie Lee Biegel want to call cut on Bobby Flay and get chefs Rashida Holmes and Dave White their close-up.
